description: This file defines the root layout and entry point for a Remix-based React web application. It sets up styles, session management, and the core layout structure.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Provides link tags for preconnecting to font resources and importing a stylesheet, used for setting up the document head links.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Asynchronous loader function that retrieves session data and determines authentication status, returning it as JSON.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: React component that defines the overall HTML structure and includes meta tags, linked styles, and layout components.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that loads root data for authentication reasons and renders nested routes.
